Nora: Quick lunch poll! Sushi, tacos, or rice bowls? Drop an emoji to vote. 
Ben: :one: Sushi 
Carlos: :two: Tacos 
Mei: :three: Rice bowls 
Nora: Vote legend: :one: Sushi :two: Tacos :three: Rice Bowl. I will randomize orders if tied.
dev-bot: Poll created: 1) Sushi 2) Tacos 3) Rice Bowl. React to vote; closing in 45m.
Asha: :two: Tacos for me. Also: taco truck near office has guac today.
Ben: Sushi counter good but I'm in the mood for guac. Hmm.
Carlos: If tacos win I will bring hot sauce packs.
Mei: If rice bowls win does someone want to split teriyaki and tofu?
Nora: High stakes: loser buys dessert.
Ben: Sold.
dev-bot: Interim tally: Sushi 1, Tacos 2, Rice Bowl 1. Still open.
Asha: Also open to doing a mix and calling it "Team Bento" if we can't decide.
Nora: Compromise option is on the table but need majority.
dev-bot: Poll closed. Final tally: Sushi 1, Tacos 3, Rice Bowl 1. Winner: Tacos.
Nora: Tacos it is. Carlos you promised hot sauce packs. 
Carlos: On it 525
Ben: Dessert on the loser? Who9s buying?
Mei: I concede and will bring mochi.
Asha: Nice. See you at 12:15 outside the lobby.
Nora: Thanks everyone!
